_doc: FACE strand: action/key -> expression. Expression names = v2/face/out/sprite/<VIEW>_<expr>.txt (VIEW S,SE,E,NE,N; W/SW/NW = mirror of E/SE/NE). Grammar: v2/face/FACE_GUIDE.md, stamps: v2/face/tools/faces.py. NE/N only change the cheek sliver (blush) - keep the same keys for consistency. 'hold' = keep the previous frame's face.

blink.rule: insert on a random idle loop boundary, never during a body-bob extreme; double-blink 1 in 5

variant_smile.use: every 3rd-4th idle loop or after a won fight

run.note: eyes forward; no blink during run

surprised.use: item pickup, enemy appears, being startled; 2-3 frames then neutral

timing_rules: Face changes land ON the key pose frame, not between keys (one-frame lead is allowed on shout: switch on the smear frame so the open mouth is already there at impact).
Never change the face on a smear frame unless the change is to shout/effort; the eye stays readable through the smear.
Hold shout through the hit-stop; return to neutral (confident smirk) on recover so she reads cocky, not exhausted.
Blink never overlaps shout/effort/pain; pain already has closed eyes.
squash also lowers the head 1 px (one skull row removed, faces.build_view does it); use it only on the landing contact frame.
